value.rationale: The original 2016 work motivates exact Eulerization length as a natural unresolved route-inspection invariant after its illustrated binary cases. Four consecutive exact higher binary orders close that first gap, and the unavoidable-repeat counts 7,14,19,38 quantify orientation-sensitive overlap overhead. The new finite sharp bounds come with reusable exact matching duals and explicit sequences, rather than an arbitrary slice or a routine recomputation of a known table.
